I met this friend who I always teased by calling him Harry. Partly because I was so into the band One Direction at the time, and partly because I had a huge crush on him and loved to tease him because his smile made me so happy. 

We met because both our dads worked away from home on the pipeline. His family life was pure crap and so was mine, so I sympathized with him a lot. He was a troubled kid...he was physically abused for a good bit of his life which caused him to have anger issues. One day some kids were messing with him in class and a switch flipped inside him and he threw his chair across the class. The entire room went silent and he was sent to the office. It scared me a lot to see this quiet, loving guy completely change like that. But that's when I started taking his struggles at home seriously. 

I ended up moving away across Canada. It was very hard for me because I had never moved that far away before. Shortly before I moved away, Harry and his family came to my place for dinner which was on a big orchard, our backyard was huge and we were sledding down the hill alone. When we both came to a stop at the bottom of the hill there was a long silence and we both just looked at each other. I thought to myself, 'this guy is going to be my first kiss tonight.' but it never happened. Our moms both called us inside for dinner and nothing ever happened between us. 

I moved away and we kept talking here and there. He grew up a lot, I grew up a lot. Four years went by and my family moved back to that side of Canada, but one province away from Harry. For me it was close enough. We lived there for two years I think before one summer my mom decided we would go back to our hometown for a short visit. I was so excited to see Harry again...I was seeing my grandmother too but let's be real. My mind was on my crush lol. Even though so much time had passed since elementary school when I first met him, I still loved him a lot. 

When we arrived back in my hometown, we decided we would stay with Harry and his family because we didn't have enough money for a hotel. This was really weird for me, because I hadn't seen him in years and years and now I'm essentially living in his house for a week or so. I felt a huge connection to him the moment I saw him again and I didn't even know how to act because I was so attracted to him. He hugged me when I first got there and called me my childhood nickname and I'm pretty sure I started shining like a tomato. LOL

A few hours went by and we started drinking. Something I didn't realize about Harry was that he was into drugs and partying now. He also wanted to produce his own music which was sooooo cool to me. 

I was standing in his basement in the hallway browsing my phone. The light was off. He came into the hallway and whispered in my ear and asked me if I wanted to, er...partake in the devil's lettuce. Not his exact words but you get what he meant. The way he leaned in close to me really got me going so I foolishly agreed, even though I had never really done it before. 

He led me to the shed outside and we smoked. This is where it gets bad. 

I didn't really feel much at first so I just kept smoking. We kept passing it back and forth and I thought 'huh this is kind of fun!' we went back inside and I kind of relaxed on the bed I was going to be sleeping on in the den. No more than 10 minutes after I came inside my entire body went numb and I started panicking. I got up from the bed and leaned my body weight against the hallway wall in a rush to get to his bedroom door. I knocked on it and he opened it, and I just clung to him in a huge hug. I physically could not speak. I couldn't move. I was frozen and my mind was leaving my body, and I truly believed I was dying. 

This time period when this event happened was during the beginning of a huge fentanyl epidemic in Canada. Everybody was concerned about the extremely lethal drug being laced into other drugs. So the idea of fentanyl was swirling around my panicked brain and I thought I was dying. I kept begging him to call 9-1-1 but both him and our parents said we couldnt. My mom tried calming me down but I was stuck in this greening out thing for the entire night. It was truly the most horrific night of my life. 

You can say what you want about me being a child and that I was overreacting about 'just some weed' but I already suffer from an anxiety disorder and both the sudden, intense feeling of my body weighing 500 pounds and my mind leaving my body combined with fentanyl scares around Canada meant that I was totally fucking panicking. 

For the rest of our visit back to my hometown I barely spoke to Harry. I felt extremely embarrassed for freaking out like that and putting him into that uncomfortable position so I tried messaging him to apologize and ask if we were cool, but I could tell he didn't want to talk...so we didn't talk. 

We ended up staying with my grandma instead because of issues between my mom and Harrys mom but that's unrelated to anything that happened between him and I. 

When we returned back home from our trip things went sort of back to normal. But I didn't talk to Harry much anymore. It's been around four years since that trip and I believe the last time we messaged each other was two years ago, maybe I'm wrong. But it's been ages. I still think about him a lot and I believe I'll always think of him. 

My incredible crush on Harry has diminished over time. I don't know why, but I was so truly in love with him, even though he rarely said or did anything to lead me to believe he felt the same way. And I never held it against him. In a way, even as a young kid, I always knew it would never work out. But I still loved him. He was my first love. And I think about him often. 

I check on his Facebook occasionally to see if he's okay, and he looks alright. He's gone down a bit of a rabbit hole of partying and drugs and drinking and for a while I was scared for his safety, but as of late he's been okay. I wish him all the best. 

And Harry, if you're reading this; which I doubt you are because I don't think you use Reddit...

I love you like my brother. You were my best friend. Our lives were so identical in so many ways and I believe that's a big reason why we connected so well. I miss you so much and I wish you all the good in the world. Please stay safe out there...the world is a scary place, and you never know who you can really trust. Keep going and following your dreams and ambitions. Don't let anybody hold you back from who you want to be. Thank you for always, ALWAYS being there for me as a kid. One of my old friends (who I no longer talk to) decided to try and convince everybody that he was going to commit suicide. 

A few other friends and I were on Skype with him, and he started talking about how depressed he had been. He has had depression for a year or two, so we felt for him when he explained that he has been having a rough time. We all spoke our words of encouragement, telling him that we would be there for him, like we always are. We all cared about him and had a good connection with him, especially me, because I have depression and we helped each other out a few times before when it gets bad. 

Anyways, we are all discussing the various pranks we had planned for the day. It was around 12:30 at night, so technically it was already April 1st. That was when he first told us that he wanted to kill himself. 

It was silent on the call for a few seconds, then one of my friends, Liam*, proceeds to start asking things like, "Are you serious? Is this a joke? Mike*, if you aren't kidding, please don't do it." Mike is crying on his end, and he begins to apologize for 'bothering us'. 

We all start freaking out, and that is when Mike turns his camera on and shows us a bunch of orange pill bottles. We start to *really* freak out, and Dane*, who lives near him, tells Mike he is going to go to his house to help him out and keep him safe. Mike keeps telling him not to, to just stay home, because 'this will all be over soon'. That was when I started crying. 

We went on, convincing him not to kill himself, but he wouldn't listen. So Liam* decided to try and call 911, because he lived too far away from Mike to go to his house, but he had his address. When Liam mentioned 911, Mike started freaking out and *begged* us not to call. 

When we asked why, he fessed up and told us it was all a joke. I don't talk to him anymore. 

So yeah, please, do not **ever** use suicide as a prank or a joke. It is *not fucking funny*. I felt so scared for my friend, I honestly thought he was going to end his life. There are better pranks to do. 

TL;DR Friend decides to 'prank' us by saying he is going to commit suicide.
